items.title: ShadowRay 2.0 Turns AI Clusters into Crypto Botnets
items.description: A threat actor is leveraging a flaw in the Ray framework to hijack AI infrastructure worldwide and distribute a self-propagating cryptomining and data theft botnet.

items.title: Malicious Blender model files deliver StealC infostealing malware
items.description: A Russian-linked campaign delivers the StealC V2 information stealer malware through malicious Blender files uploaded to 3D model marketplaces like CGTrader. [...]

items.title: Critical Flaw in Oracle Identity Manager Under Exploitation
items.description: The exploitation of CVE-2025-61757 follows a breach of Oracle Cloud earlier this year as well as a recent extortion campaign targeting Oracle E-Business Suite customers.

items.title: Infamous Shai-hulud Worm Resurfaces From the Depths
items.description: This campaign introduces a new variant that executes malicious code during preinstall, significantly increasing potential exposure in build and runtime environments, researchers said.
